newsitem.title: USA: Cablevision says to sell Maine cable systems.
newsitem.headline: Cablevision says to sell Maine cable systems.

text.p: Cablevision Systems Corp said Friday it has reached an agreement to sell its television system operations in Maine to the privately held FrontierVision Partners LP for about $78 million in cash.
The company said the operations in Maine are owned by A-R Cable Services - ME Inc.

The company said the sale is a first step in its previously announced program to concentrate on cable operations in its core geographic clusters, and to use the proceeds of non-core asset sales to help deleverage its balance sheet.
Cablevision said the A-R Cable Services systems being sold serve about 53,000 cable customers in the communities of Bangor and Lewiston in Maine.
